description: This file defines a mixin class for Slack notifications within the Apache Superset project, including methods for generating message templates, error messages, and handling embedded data with truncation for message size limits.

classes.name: SlackMixin
classes.description: A mixin class providing methods to generate Slack message templates, error messages, and handle embedded data for notifications.

methods.name: _message_template
methods.description: Generates a formatted Slack message with content details and optional table.

methods.name: _error_template
methods.description: Creates an error message template with name, description, and error text.

methods.name: _get_body
methods.description: Constructs the message body based on NotificationContent, handling text, embedded data, and truncation for size limits.
